name: FOREST layer
geo: the flat colours are a LAYOUT GUIDE: DARK GREEN = dense manuscript forest seen from high above and far away (tiny tree crowns, a few px to about 20 px across, deep greens and dark olive in shadow); LIGHT BLUE line = the ONE river, catching the sunset (exactly where the line runs); ORANGE area ringed by BLACK = a LARGE SWATHE OF BURNING FOREST: a wide front of orange flames among blackened standing trunks, charred black ground at its edge, thick dark smoke rolling up and drifting right — fill the WHOLE orange area with fire and the black ring with burnt, smouldering forest; PURE GREEN #00ff00 = empty sky above the treeline (keep it flat pure #00ff00, clean treetop edge).
rules: Follow the guide EXACTLY: no river or fire anywhere the guide does not put one; no two burning swathes alike. LIGHT AND MOOD (Matt): DARK sunset mood — the sun is low at screen-LEFT: warm gold and orange rim light on slopes that face left, deep violet-indigo shadow everywhere else, a purple-violet smoky haze that thickens with distance and veils the farther ground; fires glow orange and throw dark smoke drifting to the right. Rich, deep mineral colour (indigo, violet, rose, ochre-gold, deep green), never pastel. STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above; IMAGE 2 sets the mood, darkness and painted hand to match (NOT its layout). No towns, no villages, no houses, no characters, text, UI or border.
